answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 52052 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: zakat Question: I want to ask about zakah, I have invested 2000000 in a company for business, is there zakah on this amount. And how much I have to pay zakah from this amount? Please, reply in the light of the holy Quran and Hadith. Answer ID: 52052 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 831/693/B=06/1435) Yes, it is necessary to pay fortieth part of the amount which is invested in the business as zakah. You will have to pay 50000/- as zakah of 20 lakh. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
